'''Gold Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron that fought for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
In [[7 ABY]], Gold Squadron was made up of twelve [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptors/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], which covered the escape of the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|evacuation transports]] during the [[Battle of Folor]]. The name was also used by pilots undergoing training in the New Republic armed forces.

In approximately [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], a Gold Squadron consisting of a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] assigned to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Quenfis]]'' fought in the [[battle for the Katana fleet]]. The squadron was ordered to hold back at first, but when [[Borsk Fey'lya]] was stripped of his command, the squadron eventually assisted [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in defending the remaining [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaughts]].
